$Comment: What the Headless Horseman's daily Claim (Rewards/Hallows_Eve/Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Daily) pays.
Every roll is read on its own: the first three always pay, the rest are chances on top, two at
Lantern Bombs and then one each at the plain pieces of his armour (the Horseman's Breastplate,
Gauntlets and Greaves, members of the Hallowed set). Their flaming twins pay from his Hoard
(Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase.json). The Claim keeps each roll a player wins with a chance equal to
their share of the fight. Chance is a percent from 0 to 100. Sweets and festival tokens pay
through the Currency reward kind; a companion mod adds rolls with a file naming this table in
Name: Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Daily
